# Model zoo

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_model_docs.py; do not edit by hand -->

39 registered configurations: 35 from 14 reward-model methods and 4 protocol profiles for general VLMs and Jev. `rewardbox list` / `rewardbox info NAME --json` show the same data live; [`models.json`](models.json) is the machine-readable copy.

Columns: **runtime** says where the model executes (see [installation](installation.md)); **default sampling** is the upstream recipe the adapter applies when you do not pass a `SamplingSpec`; **score range** is the raw native scale (RewardBox never rescales outputs); **calibration** marks a frozen real-weight regression record in `rewardbox/calibration/records/`; **kind** is `official_adapter` (calls the authors' code), `model_card_reference` (no official inference code; follows the model card) or `rewardbox_extension` (an explicit RewardBox protocol: on top of official code, e.g. prefix curves, or around a general model, e.g. the Sequence / Pair prompts).
